notes.en: Registration Rp1M (Rp500k with a sibling). Tuition grades 1–2 Rp169.2M, grades 3–6 Rp179.9M per year; capital fee from Rp68M (1 year) to Rp204M (6 years). From an article; academic year not stated, likely outdated.
